architecture: Common Feature Layer -> Current State / Buy Condition / Forward Scenario

scope.rule: source scope is metadata/configuration; model formulas contain no city/district names

engine_signal.warning: 당월·직전월 조기신고는 진단용이며 엔진 거래 신호는 신고기한이 경과한 최근 완성 월을 사용

raw_early_signal.warning: 당월은 계약 후 신고가 추가될 수 있어 조기신호로 사용

finance_v2_candidate.method: Credit Availability 50% + Funding Cost 50%. Credit Availability uses housing-related loan balance increment and YoY growth; Funding Cost uses mortgage-rate level and 3m speed. M2 is context only.

alignment.mortgage_rate: score month t uses latest monthly rate <= t-1
alignment.housing_credit: score month t uses latest balance growth <= t-2

validation.gate: n>=30 and valuation×(rate level + 3m speed) downside AUC >= best single parent + 0.01

valuation_rate_stress_candidate.method: (100 - existing Value Composite) × historical mortgage-rate cost percentile / 100

relative_quantile_tiers.reason: monthly configured-band aggregates are retained; historical transaction-level rows are intentionally not retained

validation.publication_alignment: trade month t becomes eligible at score month t+1 after the reporting window; no current-month partial counts are used
validation.production_gate: history and standalone signal support are necessary but not sufficient; integrated engine validation is still required

validation.gate: n>=36; positive lag corr>=0.20 and direction AUC>=0.60; both half-sample correlations >0; lag must beat contemporaneous corr by 0.05 or AUC by 0.03
validation.reason: history is sufficient; production use still requires clear lag superiority and integrated validation

forced_selling.reason: seller leverage/default status and sale motive are not observable from authoritative sources; no inference is made

policy_credit_regime.reason: objective effective-date and quantitative credit rules are connected for current context; historical lineage is not yet complete enough for model/backtest use

rental_market_balance.meaning: KB 전세수급·전세거래 기반 단기 임대시장 균형

normalized_total.note: first observed non-January month has no monthly value because prior cumulative month is outside the requested window

structural_supply.meaning: 미분양 재고와 인허가·착공·준공은 구조공급 context로 분리하며 기존 전세수급 15% 점수에는 아직 합산하지 않음

production_decision.reason: finance_v2 passed standalone and integrated leakage-safe validation and is active in production; other candidates remain research-only until their gates pass
